svg.aria-label: A shared channel. Four people plan lunch, and Belle reads every message and stays quiet. Then Eve asks where the travel policy is, and Belle answers: it is in the handbook, section 4.
svg.title: A shared channel. Four people plan lunch, and Belle reads every message and stays quiet. Then Eve asks where the travel policy is, and Belle answers: it is in the handbook, section 4.

g.text: Belle read every message, and decided to stay quiet.
